q1.q: We're not a software company. Can we do this?
q1.a: Yes. You don't need to code. AIntern builds, tests and maintains your software. You describe what you want in plain language and decide what goes live.

q2.a: You first run the new software alongside your current tool. Only when it works better do you cancel the old one. And every change can be rolled back with one click.

q3.a: We build on a fixed, proven foundation. Your software is automatically checked for vulnerabilities every day and you get a report. A problem blocks going live.

q4.q: Am I locked in to AIntern?
q4.a: No. Code, knowledge, data and hosting are in your name. If you stop using AIntern, your software keeps running.

q5.a: In your own database, with your own hosting. Want everything, including the AI, to run in Europe only? That's possible.

q6.a: AI usage is charged at the provider's normal price. You see it as credit in the platform, with no surprises.

privacy.heading: Privacy statement
privacy.intro: Which data aintern.nl processes, why, and what rights you have.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: AIntern (aintern.nl) is responsible for processing personal data through this website.

analytics.title: Website visits (Google Analytics)
analytics.body: We use Google Analytics (measurement ID G-QQ7ZCNPB8B) to see how the website is used, such as pages visited, device, browser and approximate location. Google Analytics is loaded on every page and sets cookies. Events such as button clicks are only measured if you give consent in the cookie banner. Your choice is stored in your own browser.

intake.title: Savings calculator
intake.body: In the savings calculator you enter which software you rent and what it costs. The calculation runs in your own browser; we do not store this data. If you then book a call with these numbers, the list of software and amounts is passed to Calendly as a note.

calendly.title: Booking a meeting (Calendly)
calendly.body: Meetings are booked through Calendly. Calendly processes the name, email address and any comments you enter there, including the software list from the savings calculator if you send it along, and sends us a confirmation. Please also read the Calendly privacy policy.

email.title: Email
email.body: If you email us, we only use your details to answer your question.

purpose.title: Why we do this
purpose.body: We process data to handle and prepare your request for a conversation (at your request) and to improve the website (legitimate interest, and for event measurement your consent). We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

sharing.title: Who we share data with
sharing.body: Amazon Web Services (website hosting), Google (website statistics) and Calendly (meetings). These parties process data on our behalf or as independent controllers. Some of them may process data outside the European Economic Area; in that case this is done under the safeguards required by the GDPR.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.body: We do not keep data longer than needed for the purpose it was collected for. If you want us to delete your data sooner, let us know.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, correct or delete your data, restrict processing, object and port your data. You can withdraw consent at any time by clearing your browser storage for aintern.nl. If you disagree with how we handle your data, you can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

clients.title: Client software
clients.body: This statement covers the aintern.nl website. Software AIntern builds for clients runs in the client's own hosting and database. The client is responsible for it; arrangements are set out in the agreement with the client.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update this statement. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
